# FolioSpace

> One-link portfolio for every Indian professional — chefs, developers, students, consultants, shop owners, agencies, founders. Foliospace.in/yourname, no code, no card.

## What it is

FolioSpace turns a single URL into a public folio. Sign up with email or OAuth (GitHub, Google, LinkedIn). Pick a slug, fill in your work, ship a portfolio. The free Solo tier is yours forever; Pro adds every template, dynamic OG image, SEO tags, visit analytics, and the 10-friend referral program.

- Audience: Indian professionals who need a clean public profile without coding
- Hosting: Render (US-Oregon free tier), Neon Postgres (free tier)
- Built with: FastAPI + Jinja2 + vanilla CSS/JS (no framework, no GSAP)

## Pricing

- Solo (free): ₹0 forever. 1 clean template, share QR, PDF export, contact form to WhatsApp, passkey sign-in. "Made with FolioSpace" badge stays on.
- Pro: ₹899/yr in Year 1 (launch offer, 40% off), ₹1,499/yr from Year 2 onward. UPI AutoPay or Card AutoPay via Cashfree Payments.
- Year-1 lock: Refer 10 verified friends and Year-1 price stays locked at renewal, permanently (no downgrade).
- Cancel any time from /dashboard or your UPI app. 7 grace days on payment failure.
- The "Made with FolioSpace" badge stays on both tiers — it's our word of mouth.

### What free (Solo) gets vs what Pro adds

Solo: foliospace.in/yourname handle, 1 template, share QR, PDF export, contact form, passkey sign-in, "Made with FolioSpace" badge.

Pro adds: every template unlocked, dynamic OG image for WhatsApp/LinkedIn/X shares, SEO tags + meta control, 30-day visit analytics, 10-friend referral program (Year-1 price locked forever), custom CSS.

Not on Solo: visit analytics, dynamic OG image, SEO tags, referral eligibility.

## Public folios

Every user gets `/<slug>`. Live examples:
- https://foliospace.in/allarohithnaidu (founder)

## Referral program

10 successful referrals (signed up + verified email + published folio via `/ref/{code}`) → Year-1 price (₹899) locked at renewal forever. Daily Render cron backstop ensures no missed state transitions. No downgrade path once earned.

Cookie plumbing: `/ref/{code}` sets `fs_ref` cookie (30-day TTL, httponly, samesite=lax). Cleared on successful signup.

## API surface (public)

- `GET /sitemap.xml`: every public folio + static pages
- `GET /<slug>`: public folio (404 if `is_public=false`)
- `GET /<slug>/og.png`: dynamic Open Graph image (1200×630)
- `GET /<slug>/qr.png`: QR code for share
- `GET /llms.txt`: this file
- `GET /llms-full.txt`: full marketing copy (markdown)
- `GET /robots.txt`: blocks `/admin/`, `/dashboard/`, `/api/`, `/auth/`
- `GET /ref/{code}`: sets referral cookie, 303 to /signup

## API surface (authenticated)

- `POST /signup`, `POST /login`, `POST /forgot`, `POST /reset`
- `GET /auth/oauth/{github|google|linkedin}/start` and `/callback` and `/attach`
- `GET/POST /<slug>/manage`: edit folio (template, sections, avatar, OG, SEO, work_rail)
- `GET /dashboard`: visits analytics (Pro only), referrals (any user)
- `GET /dashboard/billing`: manage subscription, view receipts
- `GET/POST /passkey/login/{begin,complete}`: WebAuthn assertion (passkey sign-in)
- `POST /passkey/register/{begin,complete}`: WebAuthn attestation (enrol passkey)
- `GET /dashboard/passkeys`: manage enrolled passkeys (Pro)
- `DELETE /dashboard/passkey/{credential_id}`: revoke a passkey

## Tech stack

- Python 3.13 + FastAPI 0.136 + Jinja2 3.1
- PostgreSQL via psycopg 3.2 (Neon serverless)
- Cashfree Subscriptions API (UPI AutoPay, Card AutoPay) — razorpay 2.0.1 removed in Phase B migration
- Cloudinary signed direct upload (avatars, video, fonts)
- Resend for transactional email (welcome, OTP, payment events)
- webauthn 2.2 for passkey ceremonies
- itsdangerous for session cookies, bcrypt for passwords
- slowapi for rate limiting
- QR via qrcode 7.4
